entries.title: OpenCap: Golf Accuracy Qualification Against a Marker Reference
entries.rationale: OpenCap kinematics accuracy on a ~0.25 s downswing with motion blur requires simultaneous physical marker-based reference capture; synthetic or unmeasured values cannot serve as empirical acceptance.

prerequisites.name: Simultaneous physical optical marker capture and multi-camera video of golf swings with calibrated time synchronization
Joint-angle error metric pipeline by swing phase (backswing, downswing, impact) with wrist and forearm breakout

acceptance: Measured joint-angle error report by swing phase (backswing, downswing, impact) from real simultaneous capture, with wrist and forearm angles broken out.
Never report physical accuracy claims or synthetic values as empirical acceptance.

entries.title: MS-108: Observable Golf Outputs, Impact Semantics and Accuracy Budgets
entries.rationale: Advertised face/impact/load accuracy needs calibrated independent instrument comparisons beyond marker-fit residuals.

prerequisites.name: Reference instruments and marker/club calibration sufficient for claimed observables
Synchronized held-out impact/club/ball observations with independent error budgets

acceptance: Report phase-specific, peak and percentile errors with coverage against independent references.
Keep unobservable face rotation and unsupported load/impact outputs unavailable or uncertainty-qualified; pose tracking is not collision validation.

entries.title: MS-101: Independent Scientific Validation, Identifiability and Uncertainty
entries.rationale: Independent subject/trial generalization and physiological load claims need an approved cohort and synchronized reference measurements.

prerequisites.name: Independent representative subjects/trials with rights and provenance
Synchronized ground-reaction force, center-of-pressure and claim-appropriate muscle/reference evidence
Independent biomechanical reviewer and frozen validation cohort/thresholds

acceptance: Validate held-out observations without tuning on the validation set; report uncertainty coverage and domain failures.
Bind scientific claims to measured evidence; unsupported force/muscle/physiology outputs remain unqualified.
Driver/iron examples and synthetic recovery do not establish population generalization.

entries.title: Epic: Swing-to-Impact Dynamics and Acoustic Sweetness Research
entries.rationale: U4 requires synchronized physical acquisition and blinded participants; U2 integration and U3 registered numerical counterfactuals remain software/research work.

prerequisites.name: Calibrated synchronized impact, structural and microphone acquisition
Named equipment/operators, controlled ball/club/delivery conditions and traceable raw data
Approved participant protocol, consent/rights, blinded listening and analysis registration

acceptance: Predeclare matched-delivery versus matched-input estimands and separate delivery effects from collision effects.
Measure force/spin/vibration/radiation with uncertainty and held-out conditions, preserving exact provider and calibration identities.
Evaluate sweetness separately with blinded original-level and level-controlled comparisons; synthetic sonification is not perceptual evidence.

entries.title: [EPIC] Self-calibrating markerless mocap: learn camera placement and skeleton from observed swings, with strict outlier rejection
entries.rationale: Everyday-reference placement accuracy needs held-out real paper/ruler/board measurements, not only synthetic geometry tests.

prerequisites.name: Known measured camera/reference placements and independent scale/pose ground truth
Authorized capture sessions spanning declared layouts and reference geometry

acceptance: Collect held-out reference-placement accuracy evidence and report scale-only/planar ambiguity and uncertainty.
Do not publish physical accuracy claims before independent measured comparison.

entries.title: Rig soak: three-camera sessions intermittently fail to open cameras (dshow I/O error) and a camera re-enumerates mid-series
entries.rationale: Reproducing intermittent camera loss and separating bus topology/power from DirectShow causes needs the actual lab rig.

prerequisites.name: Three-camera lab rig and operator authorized to rewire its Thunderbolt/USB topology
Exact mode, timing, ffmpeg and device-arrival logs for both topologies

acceptance: Run ten consecutive three-camera captures at 1920x1200@60 with the TS4 on its own port and cameras directly connected; all supported, no re-enumeration.
Repeat with the TS4 chained to reproduce or clear the original topology rule; retain failed captures and logs.

entries.title: Epic: Deliver and Qualify the Impact Zone and Impact Explorer Product
entries.rationale: Impact Explorer physical-accuracy claims require independent calibration/measurements beyond product and numerical parity tests.

prerequisites.name: Calibrated independent club/ball/contact observations matching advertised model tiers
Equipment/condition provenance and predeclared validation accuracy budgets

acceptance: Demonstrate independent physical accuracy within the advertised domain before publishing predictive claims.
Keep unsupported approximation modes explicit and preserve no-hit, unfinished and unavailable outcomes.

entries.title: Empirical Qualification of Contact and Delivery Covariance
entries.rationale: Numerical conservation and geometric analysis cannot establish measured equipment accuracy or identify player delivery covariance without independent physical measurements.

prerequisites.name: Physical clubheads with measured mass, CG, full inertia tensor and face geometry.
Calibrated launch, spin and strike-location measurements with repeated trials.
Authorized player delivery measurement sessions and synchronized instruments.

acceptance: Preregister tolerances and measure held-out center/heel/toe/high/low impact outcomes with uncertainty.
Compare contact and flight predictions against held-out measurements and document failures.
Fit and validate player covariance using repeated synchronized delivery measurements.

entries.title: MOSAIC-10: Multi-Swing Acquisition and Registration Across Real Golfer Trials
entries.rationale: Validation against multi-swing physical golfer trials requires real human swing captures and high-speed motion instrumentation across varied skill levels that cannot be synthetically generated or self-approved by coding agents.

prerequisites.name: Cohort of human golfers under institutional protocol
Multi-camera optical motion capture or high-speed synchronized IMU instrumentation rig

acceptance: Validate phase registration variance reduction and event anchoring accuracy against multi-trial physical golfer human captures.
Never report physical accuracy claims or synthetic values as empirical acceptance.

entries.title: NSX-05: External Validation Protocol for Closed-Loop Null-Space Exploration (Instrumented Grip, Surface EMG, and Held-Out Swings)
entries.rationale: Falsifying or validating closed-loop hand-split envelopes and prior-conditioned allocations requires physical 6-axis dual-hand instrumented golf grips, synchronized high-speed motion capture, and surface EMG across held-out golfer swings that cannot be synthetically generated.

prerequisites.name: Dual-section 6-axis instrumented golf grip with calibrated bare-club mass and inertia properties matching the NSX-01 hand_on_bare_club interface
Synchronized high-speed optical motion capture, bilateral force plates, and surface EMG acquisition rig with pre-declared electromechanical delay observation model
Authorized multi-swing human golfer cohort with disjoint training and held-out test trials under institutional protocol

acceptance: Verify net bare-club wrench balance W_L + W_R == W_net^bare within propagated sensor and kinematic noise on held-out swings before evaluating internal hand splits.
Test whether measured 6-D grip-split coordinates s_1..s_6 lie within NSX-22/NSX-25 feasible envelopes and satisfy pre-registered sign/timing certificates without post-hoc weight tuning.
Evaluate surface EMG only through a pre-declared activation-proxy observation model, never as direct hand-wrench ground truth.

entries.title: NSX-55: Golf-Model Simscape Closed-Loop Export in MATLAB R2025b
entries.rationale: No existing golf Simscape model exposes joint actuation, state targets or a cut-loop closure sensor, so M, h, J_c and Jdot_v of the golf model cannot be exported until a probe-capable open-tree variant is built and validated in R2025b; the exporter, format and loader are validated on a planar rig only.

prerequisites.name: Probe-capable open-tree variant of a GS3DX golf model (joint torque inputs, position/velocity targets, acceleration outputs, cut-loop closure Transform Sensor) built and saved in MATLAB R2025b
R2025b host whose licence admits the non-virtual block count of the probe variant (the probed host prints a Home licence banner; the limit for this variant is untested)
Independent reference on the same topology and coordinate order (Pinocchio/MuJoCo/Drake/OpenSim full-body snapshot) to compare against within registry tolerances

acceptance: Run the NSX-55 exporter in MATLAB R2025b on the golf probe variant and store a matlab_export file whose model_sha256 matches the saved model.
Show M, h, J_c and Jdot_v agree with the same-topology reference within the registry tolerances before declaring CLOSED_LOOP_SNAPSHOT FULL for the golf model.
Never accept a synthetic_test_fixture, a planar-rig export or an R2026a result as golf-model acceptance evidence.
